privacy.title: Partner Privacy Notice
privacy.text:
## 1. Who we are and what this notice covers

Swiss Fintech Forum AG operates WIRROX and is responsible for the personal
information described in this notice. Our registered office is in Zug,
Switzerland. Our address is Gubelstrasse 24, 6300 Zug, Switzerland, and our Swiss
enterprise identification number is CHE-406.093.019.

This notice covers applicants to the WIRROX Partner Programme, individual
partners, people representing partner businesses, and business contacts
introduced to the programme. It explains how we handle personal information
when administering applications, referrals, portal access, commissions and
partner payments.

For privacy questions or requests, contact **compliance@wirrox.com** or write to
our address above, marked “Partner programme privacy”. For programme support,
contact support@wirrox.com.

## 2. Information we collect

We collect the following information where relevant to your participation or a
business introduction:

- Contact and application information: name, business email, company, role,
  country, website, application answers and correspondence.
- Programme and account records: email verification, staff approval, invitations,
  agreement versions and acceptance times, account status and security events.
  Authentication records include protected password verification material and
  authenticator-enrolment information.
- Referral information: business names, websites, business-contact details,
  introduction notes, registration times, attribution decisions, competing claims
  and limited business progress.
- Commission and payment information: qualifying fee references and amounts,
  statement periods, commission calculations, corrections, payment status,
  beneficiary and bank details, payment-instruction checks and relevant
  invoice/tax evidence.
- Technical information: IP address, browser/device information, request times,
  session identifiers and security or challenge information needed to operate
  and protect the website and portal.

We receive information from you, your organisation, the partner introducing a
business, the introduced business, WIRROX staff and relevant WIRROX business
records. Where needed to check an application or referral claim, we may consult
public business sources, such as a company website or business register.

Provide only information necessary for the programme. Do not place unnecessary
sensitive information, passwords, authenticator codes or bank instructions in
referral notes or ordinary support messages. Use the designated secure process
for payment instructions.

## 3. How and why we use information

We use personal information to assess applications; verify contact details and
authority; provide secure portal access and programme communications; register
introductions; identify earlier registrations and resolve duplicate claims;
show relevant referral progress; calculate, explain and reconcile commissions;
verify payment instructions and arrange partner payments; maintain accounting
and agreement evidence; handle questions, complaints and disputes; prevent abuse;
protect our systems; comply with applicable duties; and establish, exercise or
defend legal claims.

Where applicable law requires a legal basis, we rely on the following grounds
according to the purpose and your relationship with us:

| Processing | Ground where required by applicable law |
| --- | --- |
| Assessing your requested application, administering your individual partner agreement and paying you | Steps you request before a contract and performance of that contract, where you personally are the contracting party |
| Communicating with representatives of partner businesses; reviewing introductions and attribution; maintaining programme evidence | Our legitimate interests in administering business relationships, resolving claims and running an accurate partner programme, subject to necessity and your rights |
| Protecting accounts and systems, preventing abuse, handling disputes and defending claims | Our legitimate interests in security, fraud prevention and protecting legal rights, subject to necessity and your rights |
| Maintaining accounting and payment evidence | Our legitimate interests in accurate accounts and lawful business administration, subject to necessity and your rights; legal obligation where the relevant law recognises that ground |
| Disclosures required by a binding legal duty | Compliance with a legal obligation recognised by the applicable law; any disclosure outside that ground requires a separate lawful assessment |
| Optional processing for which consent is required | Your specific consent, which you may withdraw for future processing |

If necessary application, security, referral or payment information is missing,
we may be unable to approve an application, provide access, attribute a referral
or arrange payment. Optional information is not required simply to obtain access.
This notice is not a request for blanket consent. Any marketing requiring consent
will have a separate choice; you can object to direct marketing at any time.

## 4. Who receives information

Information is available to authorised staff who need it for their work. We also
use providers for programme hosting, website delivery and security, and business
email, including Railway, Cloudflare and Google Workspace. Such providers receive
information needed for their services. Banks and payment institutions receive
the information necessary to process partner payments. Professional advisers and
competent authorities may receive information where necessary for their work,
to meet legal requirements or to protect legal rights.

Your portal shows your own referral, commission and payment records. It does not
provide another partner's account, a competing claimant's identity, internal
dispute evidence, private customer files, provider pricing or full customer
transaction history. Staff may discuss the minimum necessary facts with affected
parties to resolve an attribution or payment dispute.

## 5. International processing

Our service providers and authorised personnel may process information outside
Switzerland. The accompanying **Partner Programme Provider and Transfer
Information** identifies the relevant processing countries and the applicable
protections or exceptions. It forms part of this notice and can also be requested
at compliance@wirrox.com.

Where international transfers require safeguards, these may include recognised
standard contractual clauses with the necessary Swiss or other applicable
adaptations and additional protection where required. An adequacy decision or
another permitted legal route may apply instead. The accompanying information
identifies the route actually relied on; provider location alone does not establish
that route. You can ask us for information about the safeguards and, where
applicable, a copy, subject to protection of confidential information.

## 6. How long we keep information

We apply the following periods or review criteria. We delete or anonymise
information when it is no longer needed, subject to the exceptions below.

| Record | Retention period or review criterion |
| --- | --- |
| Unverified applications | 30 days from the last meaningful applicant activity; automated reminders do not restart the period indefinitely |
| Rejected or withdrawn applications | 12 months from the final decision or withdrawal |
| Closed partner accounts and referral working records | Review for deletion or anonymisation 24 months after closure, or after the last earning window ends if later; use closure if no earning window exists |
| Commission, payout, invoice and other accounting supporting records | 10 years from the end of the relevant financial year where Swiss accounting retention requirements apply |
| Routine security and request logs | 90 days unless a longer legal, incident or claim requirement applies; mandatory audit-log classes follow their own periods, including at least one year where required |
| Programme correspondence | Review 12 months after account or application closure; necessary agreement, payment and dispute evidence follows its appropriate record category |
| Backup copies | Rolling expiry target of 90 days; accounting archives and legal holds follow their separate periods |

An unresolved claim, legal obligation or documented security incident may require
limited evidence to be kept longer. We restrict its use, record the reason and
review retained exceptions at least annually. We do not keep all application or
contact notes merely because accounting evidence must be retained. If backups are
restored, relevant deletion decisions must be reapplied. Closing or archiving an
account is not the same as erasing all records.

## 7. Security, cookies and decisions

We use access controls, authentication, audit records and protection of payment
instructions to reduce unauthorised access and misuse. No system can guarantee
absolute security. Keep your account credentials and authenticator secure.

The website and portal use cookies or similar storage for functions such as
sessions, security and saved preferences. Information about the technologies
actually used, their purposes, durations and available choices is provided in
the relevant website or portal cookie/storage information. Where required, we
ask for consent before using non-essential technologies and provide a way to
change that choice.

Automated matching may flag a previously registered business or competing claim.
Staff review partner approvals and referral attribution; matching does not itself
decide entitlement. Contact us to request review of an inaccurate match or decision.

## 8. Your privacy rights

Depending on applicable law and the circumstances, you may request access to
personal information, correction, deletion, restriction of processing, or delivery
or transfer of eligible information. Where we rely on legitimate interests, you
may object on grounds relating to your situation. Where we rely on consent, you
may withdraw it without affecting earlier lawful processing. You may object to
direct marketing without giving a reason.

Send requests to compliance@wirrox.com. We may seek proportionate evidence of
identity and must protect other people's information. We normally provide access
information free of charge within 30 days under Swiss law. Where another law
requires a different deadline, including one calendar month, we follow that rule
and explain any lawful extension, restriction or refusal. Rights are subject to
applicable exceptions, including justified legal retention.

You may complain to the Swiss Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner
(FDPIC), or to another competent data protection authority. Where European or UK
data protection law applies, this includes the competent authority for your
habitual residence, workplace or the alleged infringement, as applicable. This
notice does not limit your statutory rights or remedies.

## 9. Introductions and updates

Partners should share only necessary business-contact information, have an
appropriate basis for sharing it and inform their contacts about the introduction.
WIRROX remains responsible for its own information duties when receiving details
indirectly. This notice must be made available to the people concerned as required
by applicable law; a partner's confirmation does not replace that duty.

We will identify updates by date and version and provide additional notice where
required. Acknowledging receipt of this notice is separate from accepting the
commercial partner agreement and is not consent to unrelated processing.

terms.title: Partner Agreement
terms.text:
## 1. Parties and commencement

This Partner Agreement is between **Swiss Fintech Forum AG**, a Swiss company
limited by shares operating WIRROX, with its registered office in Zug, Switzerland,
Swiss enterprise identification number **CHE-406.093.019**, registered in the
commercial register of the Canton of Zug, and address **Gubelstrasse 24, 6300 Zug,
Switzerland** (**WIRROX**), and **the Partner identified by its name, business email, country and, where applicable, company in the WIRROX-approved registration and acceptance record** (**Partner**). Each is a **Party** and together the **Parties**.
Where the Partner is an entity, the individual accepting confirms authority to bind it.

The Agreement takes effect when WIRROX approves the Partner, the Partner accepts
the final identified agreement version and the required identity/security setup is
completed. Registration, verification, an invitation or portal access alone does not
approve a referral or create a right to commission. Neither Party is obliged to
refer or accept a minimum number of businesses.

The Commercial Schedule forms part of this Agreement. A separately approved and
identified referral-specific variation takes precedence only for that referral.
Client service agreements govern services to clients; this Agreement governs only
the relationship between WIRROX and the Partner.

## 2. Partner activity and independent status

The Partner may identify businesses that may benefit from WIRROX services and make
lawful introductions using the approved registration process. The appointment is
non-exclusive. The Partner is an independent business introducer, not an employee,
agent authorised to bind WIRROX, joint venturer, payment service provider or custodian.
The Parties' actual activity and any mandatory law take precedence over these labels.

The Partner must not:

- Agree pricing, promise onboarding acceptance, give guarantees or make commitments
  on behalf of WIRROX without specific written authority.
- Collect client funds, payment credentials, private keys or onboarding/KYC documents
  on WIRROX's behalf, or operate a client's account.
- Provide regulated advice or carry out a regulated activity under this Agreement.
- Misrepresent licensing, safeguarding, service availability, expected returns,
  commission entitlement or a client's onboarding status.
- Use unsolicited or misleading communications, unlawful lists, prohibited incentives,
  bribery or undisclosed conflicts to generate referrals.

The Partner bears its own ordinary business expenses unless WIRROX agrees otherwise
in writing. The Partner must accurately identify its relationship with WIRROX and
disclose its financial interest in an introduction where required by law or WIRROX's
approved disclosure instructions. WIRROX remains responsible for its own services,
client acceptance, due diligence, pricing and regulatory obligations.

## 3. Referral registration and attribution

The Partner should register the business's correct legal/trading name, website,
business contact details and a concise introduction through its authenticated portal
or another WIRROX-approved channel. WIRROX records the referring Partner and the
registration timestamp. A referral code is helpful but is not required when the
registration or introduction reliably identifies the Partner.

When a business contacts WIRROX or starts onboarding, WIRROX checks its business
details against existing referral registrations. Automated matches identify evidence
and competing claims; they do not by themselves grant entitlement. WIRROX staff
review the evidence, identify the actual business and confirm attribution to the
**earliest eligible registration**. The Partner must provide reasonable evidence of
the introduction when requested. Missing or tied timestamps, conflicting identity
information or competing claims remain under review until resolved with evidence.

For normal eligibility, the Partner's registration must precede the business's
onboarding application or direct introduction to WIRROX. An existing client or
pre-existing opportunity requires a separately recorded WIRROX eligibility decision
and, where applicable, an agreed exception before any entitlement is granted.
Neither a later duplicate entry nor a referral code overrides an earlier accepted
claim. A business may have only one accepted Partner attribution for the same
commission entitlement unless a specific written arrangement expressly provides otherwise.

WIRROX will communicate its attribution decision and a non-confidential explanation
of any rejection or competing claim. A review must consider registration evidence
and these rules; WIRROX will not retrospectively reassign an accepted referral merely
to avoid an accrued commission. Complaints follow clause 10. Suspected fraud or
mistakes may be reviewed, with resulting changes recorded and explained.

Self-referrals, related-party referrals, existing opportunities and any exclusion
criteria must be disclosed and decided under the Commercial Schedule. A staff test
assignment of an existing client is a validation exercise, not evidence of an
original introduction or automatic entitlement to historical commissions. It must
not backdate a registration, displace another Partner or reset an earning period.

## 4. Commission basis and rate

For each accepted, eligible referral, the Partner earns **20% of the Eligible WIRROX
Service Fee** attributable to qualifying transactions during the Earning Period.

**Eligible WIRROX Service Fee** means the WIRROX client service fee actually earned
for the relevant completed transaction under the saved client pricing rule and
applicable category: **off-ramp, on-ramp or swap**. The basis is the fee determined
for that specific client and category, supported by the applied pricing and earned-fee
record for the transaction. It is not the principal transferred, the client's gross
transaction volume, an estimated spread or an unverified provider charge.

The Parties use this client/category service fee as the agreed commissionable net
base. **Provider fees must not be deducted from it a second time.** It is not a
share of WIRROX's overall accounting profit, and unrelated overheads or expenses
are not deductions from this base. Bank-transfer charges under clause 7 are payment
charges and do not change the 20% rate or retrospectively reduce the fee base.

The formula is:

**Commission = Eligible WIRROX Service Fee × 20%.**

The transaction record must support the applied fee, category, source amount,
source currency and qualifying completion/settlement. Missing, inconsistent,
unreconciled or disputed evidence is held for review; it is not silently treated
as a zero-fee transaction. A genuine saved client fee of zero produces zero commission.
Pricing changes apply to transactions under the applicable effective pricing rule,
not retrospectively to transactions already accounted for.

Only fees attributable to the accepted client and eligible categories qualify.
There is no commission solely for registration, a lead, onboarding approval or
the promise of a future transaction. Separately invoiced fees, subscriptions,
referral bonuses or other income are excluded unless expressly added in writing.

A fee qualifies when the relevant transaction has completed with qualifying settlement and its actual earned client/category service fee is posted and supported by the applied-pricing evidence. WIRROX reconciles that evidence before publishing an approved commission. Missing or disputed evidence remains under review. A posted record alone is not independent proof of bank cash receipt.

## 5. Earning period and currency

The **Earning Period** is **12 calendar months**, beginning at the timestamp of
the client's first qualifying settled transaction. That first qualifying transaction
is included. The period ends immediately before the corresponding anniversary
timestamp 12 months later. If the anniversary day does not exist, use the last day
of that month. Timestamps and statement-month boundaries use UTC.

The start and end are recorded and disclosed to the Partner. Later transactions,
re-registration, inactivity or administrative changes do not restart or extend
the period. A transaction must qualify within the period; a later administrative
posting or reconciliation does not itself create a new earning period. Genuine
late evidence is handled through a dated statement adjustment.

The fee base and commission are recorded in the **transaction's source currency
or asset**. For example, a qualifying source-USDT transaction with a 50 USDT service
fee produces 10 USDT commission. An on-ramp paid from EUR uses the EUR source basis,
even if the client receives USDT. EUR, USD, GBP, USDT and USDC are distinct balances;
assets and networks are not treated as interchangeable.

Transactions and statements retain the original currency. No silent conversion,
cross-currency netting or substitution is permitted. Any alternative payment
currency requires separate written agreement of the rate source, valuation time,
spread/fees and resulting settlement amount before payment. A EUR-equivalent
comparison for the bank minimum does not itself convert the underlying liability.

Commission is calculated and rounded per qualifying transaction to the disclosed
ledger precision using symmetric half-up rounding: fiat currencies to two decimal
places and USDT/USDC to six accounting decimal places. Later corrections use the
same currency and precision. Supporting additional currencies or assets requires
an approved precision and settlement method before they are offered.

## 6. Monthly statements and review

WIRROX prepares statements monthly by UTC calendar month and separately by currency.
Each statement identifies the accepted client/referral, transaction references,
eligible fee basis, category, rate, commission, adjustments and relevant status.
Client-sensitive/provider evidence may be retained by WIRROX rather than disclosed
in full, but WIRROX will provide a sufficient explanation to review the calculation.

Draft, provisional, held or estimated entries are not published payment approvals.
WIRROX reviews and reconciles the qualifying evidence before approving a statement
for payment. It will not withhold an undisputed eligible amount merely because
another amount is disputed. The Partner must supply a valid invoice or other tax
documentation where required; any self-billing arrangement must be separately agreed.

Eligible balances are paid **by the 15th of the following month**, subject to the
bank-transfer minimum and carry-forward provisions in clause 7, verified payment
instructions and required documentation. If that date is not a banking day, payment
is made on the next banking day. Missing evidence or mandatory documentation must
be identified promptly, with a reason and a revised expected date.

## 7. Payment instructions minimums and shared bank charges

### 7.1 Verified destination

Payment methods, supported currencies/assets and, where relevant, networks are
**agreed case by case with the Partner**, rather than fixed in a universal list.
Record the arrangement in that Partner's Commercial Schedule before the first
payment in the relevant currency or asset. A client-specific variation, if needed,
must be recorded separately and must not change source-currency accounting or
accepted referral rights without agreement. This does not promise a rail or asset
that WIRROX cannot lawfully and operationally support.

Payment is made only to a supported destination in the Partner's name or another
destination specifically verified and approved in writing. The Partner must supply
complete, accurate bank and tax details through the designated secure process.
Changing payment instructions requires renewed verification. Bank details must not
be provided in referral descriptions or ordinary email messages.

WIRROX is not obliged to pay an unverified third party, unsupported account, prohibited
destination or asset/network for which the Parties have not agreed a safe settlement
method. WIRROX must promptly explain an instruction problem and work with the Partner
to establish a supported method; a temporary hold does not automatically cancel a
valid accrued balance. Token-denominated commission does not imply that the current
bank-instruction feature supports token withdrawals.

### 7.2 Bank-transfer minimum and monthly carry-forward

For **bank transfers**, the minimum payable balance is **EUR 100, or the sending
bank/payment institution's applicable mandatory transfer minimum if higher**. For
a permitted non-EUR bank-transfer currency, apply the equivalent threshold in that
currency and any higher applicable bank minimum. WIRROX must disclose the applicable
threshold, currency, bank requirement and comparison basis to the Partner.

The EUR-equivalent rate source and valuation time must be specified in the Commercial
Schedule before a non-EUR threshold is applied. The comparison is for the minimum
test only. Balances are accumulated separately by currency and are not combined
across currencies to reach a minimum without a separate agreed conversion arrangement.

If the approved monthly balance is below the applicable minimum, it is **carried
forward to the next month**, added to the approved balance in the same currency and
reviewed again. This repeats until the cumulative approved balance **meets or exceeds**
the applicable minimum. It is then included in that month's normal payment cycle,
subject to verified instructions and required documentation. Threshold testing is
against the approved commission balance before transfer charges, not an estimated
amount net of unknown receiving-bank fees.

Carry-forward does not cancel the balance, reset its earning dates, change its
currency, create interest or cause a previously qualified transaction to fall outside
its Earning Period. WIRROX must show opening balance, new approved amounts, corrections,
payments and closing carried balance in the monthly statement. WIRROX may not add an
undisclosed higher minimum for convenience. Any changed mandatory bank requirement
must be evidenced and communicated before it is applied.

This minimum applies to bank transfers only. Any minimum, network charge or method for a non-bank
payment must be separately agreed; this clause does not authorise token payment,
automatic conversion or indefinite deferral because no method has been arranged.

### 7.3 Shared charges

Bank transfers use **shared charges (SHA or the rail's equivalent)** where supported
and lawful: WIRROX bears charges levied by its sending bank, and the Partner bears
charges levied by its receiving bank. Shared does **not** mean a 50/50 split of a
single fee or that WIRROX deducts its sending-bank costs from the commission.

Any intermediary/correspondent-bank charges follow the permitted payment rail and
its disclosed charge allocation. Their allocation must be confirmed in the Commercial
Schedule; no clause promises an exact net amount arriving where permitted downstream
charges may apply. WIRROX will show the instructed commission payment and any known
Partner-borne charge separately. A receiving-bank charge borne by the Partner is
not an unpaid commission shortfall, but WIRROX remains responsible for an actual
underpayment of the instructed commission amount attributable to its own error.

Failed or returned transfers do not extinguish the underlying entitlement. The
Parties will correct the cause and agree any documented retry/return charge allocation
before retrying; there is no automatic undisclosed deduction. Recording Paid requires
payment evidence, not merely creation or approval of a payout record.

## 8. Corrections refunds and taxes

A cancelled, reversed, refunded or fraudulently generated fee does not support a
commission to the extent WIRROX did not earn or retain that fee. Corrections must be
linked to the original transaction, use the same currency, show the reason and
amount, and be notified in a statement. No Paid record may be silently rewritten.

After written notice, documented and undisputed overpayments may be corrected against future commissions in the same currency. Disputed corrections follow clause 10. Cross-currency set-off, a separate repayment obligation or a repayment timetable requires a separate agreement or an applicable legal basis; no such obligation is implied by a portal status. Routine provider costs or ordinary changes in WIRROX profitability do not change the agreed fee base.

The Partner is responsible for its own taxes and business registrations. Applicable VAT or similar taxes, invoice or agreed self-billing requirements and lawful withholding treatment must be recorded with the Partner before the first payment. No optional tax deduction, self-billing mandate or tax-inclusive price is assumed from portal access.
WIRROX may make deductions required by applicable law, must identify the legal basis
and amount, and must provide available supporting documentation. This does not
authorise discretionary tax or administrative charges.

## 9. Confidentiality data protection and brand use

Each Party must protect the other's non-public business, client, technical and
commercial information, use it only to perform this Agreement, restrict access to
people who need it, and maintain appropriate security. Information already public,
lawfully obtained independently or independently developed is excluded. A legally
required disclosure is permitted, with prior notice where lawful and practicable.

The Partner must have a lawful basis to disclose a business contact's personal data,
give any required notice, obtain consent where required, and share only the minimum
accurate information needed for the introduction. WIRROX must provide its approved
privacy information, identify the applicable controller, and handle the information
for disclosed purposes under applicable data-protection law. Agreement acceptance
is not blanket consent for unrelated marketing or all client-data processing.

The Partner receives only the information needed to follow its own confirmed
referrals and published statements. It has no right to a client's account access,
KYC records, raw provider payloads, payment credentials, other partners' information
or unrelated transactions. Each Party must promptly report a relevant security
incident through the designated contact and cooperate on required notifications.

The Parties' controller/processor roles, approved notices, recipient locations,
retention periods, international transfers and rights-request process must be
confirmed before live personal data is exchanged. A separate data-processing
agreement is required if the actual relationship calls for one. Return, deletion
or restriction of information on exit is subject to lawful retention obligations,
outstanding disputes and financial/audit evidence; test-record cleanup is not a
promise to erase legally required records or external communications.

WIRROX grants a limited, non-exclusive, revocable right during the Agreement to use
approved WIRROX materials solely for authorised introductions. The Partner may not
alter marks, impersonate WIRROX, register confusing domains/accounts or publish
unapproved claims. Each Party retains its intellectual property. Required software
attribution and corresponding-source obligations are unaffected by branding.

## 10. Questions records and disputes

The Parties will nominate working contact addresses in the Commercial Schedule.
The Partner should raise a statement or attribution question promptly and identify
the disputed entries and supporting evidence. Please raise questions within 30 calendar days after the relevant statement or decision is provided. WIRROX will acknowledge and review them without unreasonable delay. This is a review target, not an automatic waiver of rights. Failure to object within that period must not automatically validate a
fraudulent entry, clear calculation error or waiver prohibited by mandatory law.

WIRROX retains auditable records supporting attribution, applied pricing, settlements,
statements, corrections, acceptance and payment confirmation. On a reasonable request
it will provide a calculation explanation or appropriately redacted supporting extract
without exposing unrelated client information. Material unresolved matters are
escalated to the nominated responsible person before formal proceedings, without
preventing urgent protective relief or mandatory rights.

## 11. Suspension termination and final balances

Either Party may terminate on **30 days' written notice**. WIRROX may
suspend access or terminate sooner for material breach, fraud, unlawful conduct,
security risk or a legal/regulatory requirement. Where lawful and appropriate,
WIRROX will explain the reason and permit a reasonable opportunity to remedy a
remediable breach. A suspension is not an automatic cancellation of accrued rights.

On exit the Partner must stop representing an active WIRROX partnership, stop using
the portal and WIRROX materials as instructed, and return/delete/restrict confidential
data as required under clause 9. Revoking access does not delete financial or
attribution evidence. WIRROX will provide statement access or another reasonable
method to review outstanding amounts if portal access is closed.

Accepted, valid referrals retain their original
12-month Earning Period after termination, unless a specifically evidenced legal
prohibition or referral-related fraud/breach removes eligibility. Accrued lawful
commissions are not forfeited merely because the relationship ends. No new referrals
qualify after termination unless separately accepted in writing.

Any final balance below the bank-transfer minimum remains owed. WIRROX will issue
a final reconciliation within **30 days** after the last eligible adjustment is
determined, and the Parties will agree a lawful supported way to pay the remaining
amount within **60 days** after that reconciliation. If the bank's mandatory minimum
prevents that transfer, the Parties must agree an alternative method, approved
conversion or other lawful settlement arrangement; no balance is automatically
forfeited or carried forward indefinitely without a documented resolution.
Confidentiality, accrued payment duties,
data protection, audit/correction and dispute provisions survive as necessary.

## 12. Responsibility liability and legal terms

Each Party is responsible for its own breach, misconduct and legal obligations.
Neither Party guarantees that a referred business will be accepted, transact or
generate a particular commission. WIRROX must nevertheless account and pay according
to this Agreement for transactions that qualify.

Responsibility and liability are determined under this Agreement and applicable law. No agreed financial liability cap, exclusion of mandatory liability or additional indemnity is created by this Agreement. Accrued lawful payment obligations remain enforceable.

Neither Party may assign this Agreement without the other's written consent,
except a disclosed permitted business succession arrangement agreed in the final
terms. Events beyond reasonable control may excuse the affected performance to
the extent permitted by law while the affected Party gives notice and mitigates;
they do not automatically erase accrued balances.

Material amendments must be notified with a clear effective date and accepted where
required. WIRROX gives 30 days' notice of material future programme changes. Changes do not
silently rewrite the rate, fee basis or Earning Period already recorded for an
accepted referral. Each accepted version and any referral-specific variation must
remain identifiable. No amendment authorises an unagreed currency conversion.

This Agreement and its agreed schedules contain the Parties' arrangement on the
Partner programme. A waiver must be specific; invalid provisions are adjusted only
as permitted by applicable law, leaving the remainder effective where possible.
Nothing excludes mandatory rights or changes the applicable legal character of
the actual services. This Agreement is governed by **Swiss substantive law**, subject to any applicable
mandatory rules that cannot lawfully be excluded. The **competent courts in Zug,
Switzerland** shall have jurisdiction over disputes arising out of or in connection
with this Agreement, subject to any mandatory jurisdiction rules.

This Agreement is made in **English**, which is its controlling language. Any
translation is for convenience; in the event of inconsistency, the English version
prevails, subject to mandatory law. The agreement-language choice does not override
mandatory procedural language requirements of the competent court.

## Commercial Schedule

| Item | Programme term |
| --- | --- |
| Partner | Identified by the approved registration and acceptance record; an entity's accepting representative confirms authority |
| Commission | 20% of the actual earned WIRROX client/category service fee; no second provider-fee deduction |
| Categories | Off-ramp, on-ramp and swap |
| Earning Period | 12 calendar months from the first qualifying settled transaction, UTC |
| Currency | Source currency/asset; separate balances; no implicit FX |
| Attribution | Staff review and earliest eligible registration; no referral code required |
| Existing clients and related parties | Disclose and obtain a recorded eligibility decision. A test assignment gives no historical entitlement |
| Monthly settlement | By the 15th of the following month, next banking day if needed, subject to the agreed minimum and required documentation |
| Bank minimum | Higher of EUR 100 equivalent and the mandatory sending-bank minimum; same-currency monthly carry-forward |
| Bank charges | Shared: WIRROX sending-bank charges; Partner receiving-bank charges. Disclose intermediary allocation before payment |
| Payment method and comparison rate | Agree supported method, asset/network where relevant, non-EUR threshold rate source/time and fees case by case before payment. No automatic conversion |
| Taxes and documentation | Record applicable tax, invoice/self-billing and withholding treatment before the first payment |
| Questions and privacy | support@wirrox.com; privacy requests to compliance@wirrox.com; Partner notice address is its registered business email |
| Termination | 30-day notice; preserve eligible accepted-referral windows; final reconciliation within 30 days and settlement arrangement within 60 days as stated in clause 11 |
| Law and jurisdiction | Swiss substantive law; competent courts in Zug, Switzerland; English controlling language; mandatory rules preserved |

providers.title: Providers and Transfers
providers.text:
## Providers and purposes

| Service | Provider | Processing and protection |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CRM, database, files and recovery | Railway Corporation, United States | The programme runtime and storage are in the United States. Public edge processing also takes place in the countries listed below. The incorporated DPA provides the applicable Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework route for covered certified processing and Swiss-adapted standard contractual clauses for relevant restricted transfers |
| Website delivery and security challenges | Cloudflare, Inc., United States, and relevant group/subprocessors | Global edge delivery and security process request, network and relevant submitted information. The incorporated DPA provides the applicable Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework route and adapted contractual safeguards. A Switzerland-only processing restriction is not applied |
| Business email | Google Cloud EMEA Limited, Ireland; Google LLC and relevant Workspace subprocessors | Google Workspace processes programme correspondence and contact information. The accepted Cloud Data Processing Addendum and its applicable Swiss transfer arrangements govern covered processing |
| Payments and professional advice, when used | The selected bank/payment institution and necessary legal, accounting or tax adviser | We identify the recipient, necessary information, relevant countries and applicable protection before using a new payment or adviser arrangement. The registration pilot does not initiate a payment |

Information is limited to what is needed for the relevant service. A provider's
published global locations are potential processing locations, not evidence that
every programme record travels through every listed country.

## Google Workspace processing countries

The published core-service subprocessor information identifies Argentina,
Australia, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, Colombia, Denmark,

United Kingdom and United States. This is core-service processing coverage;
it does not mean that every email is processed in all those locations.

[Google Workspace subprocessors](https://workspace.google.com/terms/subprocessors.html).

## Railway edge processing

The runtime, database and file target is in the United States. Public edge/TLS
request processing has a broader footprint: Australia, Belgium, Brazil, Canada,
France, Germany, Hong Kong, Italy, Japan, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Romania,
Singapore, South Africa, Spain, Switzerland, United Kingdom and United States.
Routing and availability may change. An edge location is distinct from the
database or file-storage location.

[Railway DPA](https://railway.com/legal/dpa).

## Cloudflare service and support processing

The relevant published developer-platform provider entries include the United
States, European Economic Area, Australia, India, United Kingdom, Japan, Canada
and Singapore. Group support locations also include France, Germany, Malaysia,
Mexico, Netherlands, Portugal, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland and United Arab

location appendix. Regional or specialist products are not assumed to be enabled
merely because they appear in a vendor-wide list.

[Cloudflare service subprocessors](https://www.cloudflare.com/gdpr/subprocessors/cloudflare-services/).

## Safeguards, changes and questions

The relevant U.S. providers' Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework participation was
checked for covered processing. Where that route does not cover a relevant
restricted transfer, the applicable incorporated contractual safeguards and any
necessary additional measures apply. Our partner privacy notice explains how to
request information about safeguards, exercise rights and contact us.

We review material changes in recipients and processing locations before using
them for the programme. Contact compliance@wirrox.com for further information or
an applicable safeguard copy, subject to protection of confidential information.


## Potential Cloudflare edge locations

cookies.title: Partner Cookies and Storage
cookies.text:
## Sessions and storage

| Technology | Purpose and duration |
| --- | --- |
| Portal authentication cookies | Essential sign-in and security. Session cookies; the server limits portal sessions to at most one hour and 15 minutes idle, with stricter applicable limits preserved. Logout invalidates the session |
| Tab-session credential storage | Supports the signed-in portal in that tab; cleared through native logout. Browser session restoration may restore tab state, so server expiry remains authoritative |
| Local browser preferences and metadata | Theme choices and application cache/last-user metadata may remain until cleared. They do not themselves grant authenticated access |
| Introduction attempt identifier | Session storage helps recognise retries; contact details and the referral code are not stored in that identifier. Cleared after a successful introduction |
| Cloudflare Turnstile | Security verification for application and verification forms. Challenge tokens are short-lived and single-use. Cloudflare processes relevant request/security information; its provider information explains locations |

No optional advertising analytics or session replay is enabled in the reviewed partner release. Required security processing is distinguished from optional tracking. We obtain any required choice before adding non-essential tracking. You can clear browser storage through browser controls; doing so may sign you out or reset preferences.

## Questions and source access

For programme support and access to the corresponding source of the portal software, contact support@wirrox.com. For privacy or storage questions, contact compliance@wirrox.com. Source requests do not require an active partner membership.
